# sq-38 — Sketches under the memory budget

Brings the per-field sketches under the memory budget. Today each field that crosses a cap holds a fixed 16 KiB HyperLogLog plus a Greenwald-Khanna summary (two for an ambiguous date field). `EstimatedBytes` counts them, but no budget limits them, so a wide table where many fields cross caps can exceed the allowance (sq-11 review: about 280 MB for 2,000 numeric fields, more for ambiguous dates).
